scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm run db:setup --prefix server
scripts.build: npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm run db:generate --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
